futureEnhancements.title: Fix volume bar overlay
futureEnhancements.description: Volume bars currently marked as experimental and disabled by default. Need to fix alignment and visual rendering issues.
futureEnhancements.notes: Braille chart uses 2 data points per character causing alignment issues with volume bars

futureEnhancements.title: Replace Yahoo RSS news feed (BROKEN)

futureEnhancements.notes: yfinance ticker.news returns rich news data - title, summary, source, URL. No API key needed!

futureEnhancements.title: Replace CoinGecko with yfinance for crypto
futureEnhancements.description: Switch crypto data from CoinGecko to yfinance using USD pair format (e.g., BTC-USD, ETH-USD). Eliminates rate limit issues and simplifies codebase to single data source.
futureEnhancements.notes: yfinance supports crypto with format SYMBOL-USD. Benefits: (1) No rate limits, (2) Single unified API, (3) Consistent data format.

futureEnhancements.title: In-app article reader mode
futureEnhancements.description: Fetch and display news article content directly in terminal instead of opening browser. Reader mode strips ads/chrome and renders clean text.
futureEnhancements.notes: Essential for headless/server environments without display. Avoids eye strain from bright browser. Libraries: newspaper3k, readability-lxml, or trafilatura for article extraction. Render with Rich/Textual markdown support.
